FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
ImphaI, the llth September, 2026
HCMEST-r20rr/r/2026-Egrr-ii SEcrioN-HCM/ / 777S . : in continuation of this
Registry’s Advertisement of even No. dated 4th June, 2026 and Notification of even
number dated 14 d1 July, 2026, and in view of the Judgment dated 21st August, 2026
passed by the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India in W.P. (C) No. 1110/2025 and
connected matters, it is hereby notified that:
1. The requirement of submission of a Certificate of Practice by candidates for
direct recruitment to the post of Manipur Judicial Service Grade – Ill, as
advertised vide this Registry’s Advertisement of even No. dated 4th June, 2026,
is hereby dispensed with, in conformity with the directions of the Hon’ble
Supreme Court of India.
Accordingly, all law graduates shall be eligible to apply notwithstanding the
three-year practice requirement. No separate Certificate of Practice shall be
required to be furnished in support of the said eligibility requirement.
The last date for submission of the application forms shall be 04:00 P.M. on 9th
October, 2026. Applications received after the stipulated date and time shall
not be entertained.

3.
Note: Applicants are advised, in their own interest, to complete and submit the online
Application Form well before the closing date and not wait until the last date, so as to
avoid the possibility of disconnection, inability, or failure due to heavy internet traffic
or website load.
(OJESH MUTUM)
REGISTRAR GENERAL
